title: Lovely Crunchy Venezuelan Apple Empanadas
description: A salty and crunchy Venezuelan dish featuring Bramley apples, perfect as a post-workout snack, and an egg-free friendly option using coconut cream crack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a few slices of apple onto the center of each dough circle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water, then fold the dough in half over the apple and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little coconut cream crack and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
